decisions.briefing: Markets were mixed and directionless today (NASDAQ -0.5%, S&P 500 +0.1%), with no clear risk-on signal. Cash on hand ($89.29) is well below the $500 deployment threshold, so no new positions were opened despite 3 open slots. Existing 7 positions are held unchanged; stop-loss and profit-target rules remain active in the background.

market_education.summary_en: Today's action was mixed and largely rangebound, with the S&P 500 essentially flat while the NASDAQ slipped modestly. No single catalyst drove the divergence; it reflects a market digesting recent gains rather than reacting to a specific shock. With no strong directional signal, this was a low-conviction, wait-and-see session.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市方向不明,標普500指數幾乎持平,納指則輕微回落。今次分歧並非由單一事件觸發,反而反映市場在消化近期升幅後進入觀望狀態。由於缺乏明確方向訊號,今日屬於低信心、按兵不動的交易日。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A 'risk-off' day is when investors pull back from adding new positions because market signals aren't strong enough to justify the risk. It doesn't mean panic-selling — it just means staying disciplined and waiting for clearer confirmation before committing more capital.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「風險規避」（Risk-Off）是指投資者在市場訊號不夠明確時,選擇不增持新倉位。這並非恐慌性拋售,而是保持紀律,待訊號更清晰時才再投入資金。
